reviewed_extent: Entire quality.py, joined.py, independent reference, all 18 new test methods, complete protocol and frozen golden cases, implementation coverage, graph contract and source-wide callers in src/tests/references.
Root source-case preparation retained; no native cohort or economic execution inferred.

findings.trigger: Aggregate support infers full positive coverage from an empty incident set.
findings.correction: Require immutable positive observed spans scoped to field/operation/evidence availability; report unknown duration separately. Preserve toy golden numbers by supplying explicit full-span witnesses.

findings.trigger: Copied old valid content or later receipt of an older revision supersedes the newer invalid revision.
findings.correction: Use economic observation and revision/origin precedence; receipt must not promote copied revisions. Correct independent reference and add copied-invalid and late-old regressions.

findings.trigger: Same observation/revision with different receipt clocks bypasses conflicts; equal aliases with different receipts lose acquisition lineage.
findings.correction: Reject conflicting economic signatures for same field/observation/revision regardless of receipt; retain all available identical acquisition versions without refreshing origin age.

findings.trigger: FieldFact defaults to every operation without capability evidence.
findings.correction: Default available_operations to empty or require explicit capabilities; generic eligibility cannot certify all operations.

findings.trigger: OI coverage treats any observed contracts-valued field as OI and any field as quote.
findings.correction: Require explicit immutable OI field role and required quote component/operation contract; count only all required PIT components. Toy composite quote may be explicitly registered; invent no vendor mapping.

findings.trigger: Bindings, bounds and configuration_version are writable after timelines are built.
findings.correction: Expose private immutable configuration with read-only properties; verify reassignment rejection and restore identity.

findings.trigger: Direct interval/aggregate calls bypass recovery validation and permit book recovery to close missing flow history.
findings.correction: Validate recovery identity, kind, scope, timing and duplicate consistency in direct production and reference helpers before computation.

findings.trigger: No expected stream, no liveness and zero trades becomes observed_no_event.
findings.correction: Return explicit not_expected/unobserved without positive evidence; known quiet heartbeat remains observed_no_event. Correct nongolden expectation.

findings.trigger: Admitted support can lack observation/lineage fields or contain mutable acquisition pairs, causing forged availability or join TypeError.
findings.correction: Validate admitted clocks, identities and payload; require immutable unique acquisition pairs and coherent liveness clocks, raising ContractError for malformed support.

findings.trigger: Quality propagation ignores mandatory/optional empty-field provenance edges.
findings.correction: Propagate producer unavailability through mandatory same-cut provenance dependencies, record optional omissions and dirty consumers, preserve selective fields and lagged/unconditional contracts.
